entries.description: Execute a sequence of browser tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — if an action navigates to a domain without permission, the next item's check fails and the batch stops. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested.

name.description: Tool name (e.g. computer, navigate, find, tabs_create_mcp). browser_batch cannot be nested.

input.description: That tool's input — same shape you'd pass when calling it directly. For computer items whose action is left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key or type, and for form_input items, include action_summary in the item's input, as you would when calling that tool directly.

actions.description: List of tool calls to execute sequentially.     return f"{mon}\t"+"\t".join(f(x) for x in v)

def yoy(a,b): return round((a-b)/b*100,1) if b else None
def yurl(m): return f"https://car.yiche.com/paihangbang/salesdetail/?type=1&serialId={raw[m]['id']}"

    base=dict(kind='metric',region='CN',powertrain='all',unit='units',yoy_pct=None,verified=True,notes='')
    base.update(k); items.append(base)

    fy=ssum(m,fy_months,col); h1=ssum(m,H1,col); h125=ssum(m,H125,col)
    colname={'retail':'零售量 (retail)','term':'终端量 (terminal/insurance registrations)'}[col]
    add(id=f"{slug}-cn-{fy_label.lower()}",checkpoint='2026-01',entity=entity,segment=seg,powertrain=pt,metric=metric,period_covered=fy_label,value=fy,

def ymonth(slug,entity,m,seg,pk,pt,col,rel,driver='Not stated by source.',notes_dec='',notes_jun=''):

YNOTE=("Yiche (易车榜) model sales-history page, columns 批发量/零售量/出口量/终端量 (wholesale/retail/export/terminal=insurance registrations); "
       "Yiche states data is 'industry composite', updated ~10th of following month, so published_at is approximate; page retrieved 2026-10-11. "
       "Wholesale column reproduces CPCA/Gasgoo figures (e.g. 5 Series FY2024 wholesale 86,174). Domestic-built models only have wholesale/retail; imports only terminal.")
items=[]
def add(**k):
    base=dict(kind='metric',region='CN',powertrain='all',unit='units',yoy_pct=None,verified=True,notes='')
    base.update(k); items.append(base)

def ypair(slug,entity,m,seg,pk,pt,col,driver_fy,driver_h1,rel,fy_months=FY,fy_label='FY2025',extra_fy='',extra_h1='',fy_prev=None):
    metric='retail_sales' if col=='retail' else 'registrations'
    fy=ssum(m,fy_months,col); h1=ssum(m,H1,col); h125=ssum(m,H125,col)
    colname={'retail':'零售量 (retail)','term':'终端量 (terminal/insurance registrations)'}[col]
    add(id=f"{slug}-cn-{fy_label.lower()}",checkpoint='2026-01',entity=entity,segment=seg,powertrain=pt,metric=metric,period_covered=fy_label,value=fy,
        yoy_pct=yoy(fy,fy_prev) if fy_prev else None,
        headline=f"{entity} China {fy_label} {metric.replace('_',' ')}: {fy:,}",driver=driver_fy,customer_relevance=rel,pair_key=pk,
        source=dict(url=yurl(m),publisher='Yiche 易车榜',published_at=YPUB['2026-01'],trust_tier='T3'),
        quote=row(m,'2025年12月'),verified=False,
        notes=f"Value = sum of the {len(fy_months)} monthly {colname} rows on the page (computed by researcher; Dec row quoted). "+extra_fy+" "+YNOTE)
    add(id=f"{slug}-cn-h1-2026",checkpoint='2026-07',entity=entity,segment=seg,powertrain=pt,metric=metric,period_covered='H1-2026',value=h1,
        yoy_pct=yoy(h1,h125) if h125 else None,
        headline=f"{entity} China H1 2026 {metric.replace('_',' ')}: {h1:,}",driver=driver_h1,customer_relevance=rel,pair_key=pk,
        source=dict(url=yurl(m),publisher='Yiche 易车榜',published_at=YPUB['2026-07'],trust_tier='T3'),
        quote=row(m,'2026年6月'),verified=False,
        notes=f"Value = sum of Jan–Jun 2026 monthly {colname} rows (computed; Jun row quoted); YoY vs H1-2025 sum {h125:,}. "+extra_h1+" "+YNOTE)

def ymonth(slug,entity,m,seg,pk,pt,col,rel,driver='Not stated by source.',notes_dec='',notes_jun=''):
    metric='retail_sales' if col=='retail' else 'registrations'
    for cp,mon,per,prev in [('2026-01','2025年12月','Dec-2025','2024年12月'),('2026-07','2026年6月','Jun-2026','2025年6月')]:
        v=raw[m][mon][COL[col]]; p=raw[m].get(prev,[None]*4)[COL[col]]
        add(id=f"{slug}-cn-{per.lower()}",checkpoint=cp,entity=entity,segment=seg,powertrain=pt,metric=metric,period_covered=per,value=v,yoy_pct=yoy(v,p) if p else None,
            headline=f"{entity} China {per} {metric.replace('_',' ')}: {v:,}",driver=driver,customer_relevance=rel,pair_key=pk,
            source=dict(url=yurl(m),publisher='Yiche 易车榜',published_at=YPUB[cp],trust_tier='T3'),quote=row(m,mon),verified=True,
            notes=(notes_dec if cp=='2026-01' else notes_jun)+f" YoY vs {prev} row on same page. "+YNOTE)

I wrote 77 items (38 for 2026-01, 39 for 2026-07, 0 gaps-duplicates with checkpoints.json) to /Users/atahankilic/Documents/ehl-munich-final/research/checkpoints/raw/china_models.json. **Sources:**
- **Yiche (T3), main source.** Its model pages show monthly wholesale, retail and insurance-registration figures. The wholesale column matches CPCA/Gasgoo.
- **CarNewsChina:** ECC (Haidaxing) monthly rankings of sedans above RMB 700k.
- **Dated articles:** 163.com (FY ranking), ifeng (H1 ranking), IT Home (FAW-Audi figure), Tencent News.

**Key figures:**
- **FY2025 retail:** A6L 170,821 (FAW-Audi says 172k), E-Class 130,810, 5 Series 116,173.
- **H1 2026 retail:** E-Class 61,225 (−7%), A6L 59,253 (−30%), 5 Series 48,041 (−19%).
- **June 2026:** 5 Series 6,965 retail (−48%), 4,911 wholesale.
- **Luxury registrations, FY2025:** 7 Series 9,525, S-Class 10,321, S800 11,924 (May–Dec only).
- **Luxury registrations, H1 2026:** 7 Series 3,671, S-Class 3,481, S800 6,961, Maybach S 4,270.
- **June 2026:** S800 581, 7 Series 390.

**Gaps:**
- Gasgoo is blocked by bot protection and the search budget ran out.
- No i7 figures and no Maybach S FY2025 total.
- No volumes for U8, Zeekr 007 or the Z9 sedan; iX3 LWB orders fall after the July cut-off.
- No reported BBA share of the segment.
